# HerbalBath 草本沐

> HerbalBath (草本沐) is a Singapore brand that sells Myrrh Herbal Energy Oil (没药草本能量油, 55ml): an herbal oil made with myrrh, frankincense and up to 15 Chinese herbs, for external use. The site is written for Mandarin-speaking Singaporeans aged 55 and over and their families, in Simplified Chinese with an English toggle.

Key facts:

- Product: Myrrh Herbal Energy Oil 没药草本能量油, 55ml, from HerbalBath 草本沐, a Singapore brand.
- Ingredients we name: myrrh, frankincense and up to 15 Chinese herbs.
- Use: external use only. Apply to the shoulders, back or knees and press gently with the palm for about 10 seconds, twice a day. A warm feeling comes within about 10 seconds. One bottle lasts 3-4 months at twice a day.
- Price: S$39 a bottle; buy 3 get 1 free (4 bottles for S$117). Free delivery anywhere in Singapore. 30-day money-back guarantee.
- How to buy: PayNow at https://herbalbathsg.com/pay (the amount and reference are filled in), WhatsApp or phone +65 8426 1225, or Shopee.
- Contact: hello@herbalbathsg.com, WhatsApp +65 8426 1225.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Product information on this site is general and isn't medical advice. For pain that is severe, sudden or lasting, people should see a doctor.
